title: Marshall's Spatchcock Sunday Roast
ingredients: Chicken & Veg: 1 medium spatchcock chicken, 800g chopped potatoes, 4 halved shallots, 1 halved garlic bulb, 0.5 lemon, olive oil, salt, pepper, fresh thyme
Lettuce: 2 little gem lettuces, halved lengthways
Gravy: 25g butter, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard, 150ml white wine, 1-2 tsp honey, 2 tbsp chopped cornichons, handful of chopped parsley, 250-350ml chicken stock
steps: Place potatoes, shallots, garlic, and lemon in roasting tray. Top with chicken, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Roast at 200°C fan/220°C for 45-60 mins until chicken reaches 75°C. Remove chicken to rest.
Transfer potatoes to another tray and roast for another 15-20 mins until crisp.
Mash roasted garlic into the original tray with juices. Add butter, mustards, wine, honey, cornichons, and parsley, then warm over medium-low heat.
Nestle lettuce into the sauce, cover, and gently simmer for 5-8 mins until tender.
Stir chicken stock and resting juices into the tray, reduce to desired thickness, and serve.
